an5.192:2.10: For I, Worthy Gotama, am a brahmin well born on both sides—

an5.192:7.4: For forty-eight years he leads the boy’s spiritual life studying the hymns.
an5.192:7.5: Then he seeks a fee for his tutor, but only by legitimate means, not illegitimate.
